verdict.rationale: Fastmail has first-party help articles for both Masked Email and aliases, and a long-time user confirms masked emails work well for throwaway or sketchy sites. That covers the core of hiding the real address from sign-ups and strangers. Missing for 10: substantive doc content beyond article titles (how masked addresses are created, managed or disabled), and evidence that outgoing replies sent from an alias or masked address keep the real address hidden.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address

citations.quote: Masked emails have been so nice for throwaway/sketchy sites.
